log.reply:
**Subject: Executive Briefing proposal for Tamarack Instruments**

Dear Dana Whitfield,

**Situation summary**

Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. The Client has deployed a customer service chatbot on its support portal. It is piloting AI visual inspection on the German production line and plans AI sales forecasting next year. Your stated objective is: "I want governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027." The Client Profile records an internal audit finding from June 2026 of no inventory of AI systems. It lists ISO/IEC 42001 as a certification target, with work to start next year. The stated constraints are that customer data must stay in the EU and that the German works council is consulted before anything touches production staff.

**What the Briefing covers for the Client**

The Briefing will map the EU AI Act and GDPR to each use case. For the chatbot, we will review transparency expectations for AI systems that interact with people and GDPR considerations for customer data, including EU data residency. For visual inspection, we will examine how EU AI Act risk classification may apply and where works council consultation could sit as a governance gate before Q2 2027. United States expectations will appear only as a general landscape item, since no US driver is listed. We will discuss how AI governance could align with the ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS, ISO 9001 quality management system and internal audit function named in the profile. We will also cover what building an AI system inventory involves. The operating model draws on the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen), with AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards) as the board-layer reference. It is guided by three principles: Slow AI, Informed Intent and Final Liability rests with the Human. All regulatory points are expectations to verify with counsel, not legal advice.

**Logistics and price**

The Executive Briefing is a two-hour, live virtual session for executive leadership and board-level attendees, priced at US$3,000. The audience roles listed are General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors.

**What the Client receives afterward**

The Client receives a post-briefing summary memo with decisions surfaced and readiness observations. It also includes three prioritized recommendations, each mapped to a next program option: Executive Workshop, Practitioner Academy or Implementation Accelerator. We do not promise certification, audit outcomes or regulatory approval, including for ISO/IEC 42001.

**Next step**

A decision is expected by 15 December 2026. At intake, please confirm the preferred session date, the final attendee list and whether the visual inspection pilot processes personal data of production staff.

Kind regards,

Senior AI Governance Consultant
AI Governance Academy

Human-made, for Easy Work, Simply Done.
